q13.sourceTranscription: $\frac{2\log_2 n+1}{3}$의 값이 60이하의 자연수가 되도록 하는 모든 $n$의 값의 합은?
q13.independentSolve: Let k=(2 log_2 n+1)/3 in {1,...,60}. Then log_2 n=(3k-1)/2. Since n is a natural integer, k must be odd; k=1,3,...,59 gives n=2^(1+3j), j=0,...,29. The sum is 2(8^30-1)/7, far outside every printed choice 136,141,146,151,156.
